description: Dependency-update policy for docker-autoheal. Renovate creates and maintains dependency PRs. Only eligible patch updates (not 0.x) are automerged once required checks pass; all other updates require manual review and merge. See docs/maintainer/dependency-management.md for the full explanation.

packageRules.description: Require manual review and merge for all dependency updates. No Renovate update is automatically merged.

Coordinate major upgrades of the interdependent frontend build and test toolchain in one PR, so lockfile generation sees compatible Vite, Vitest and plugin majors together. Patch and minor updates keep their normal grouping.

Automerge eligible patch updates once all required CI checks pass. Excludes 0.x versions, where a patch can still be breaking. Minor and major updates keep automerge disabled. Relies on GitHub required status checks; see docs/maintainer/dependency-management.md.
Pin Docker image tags to an immutable SHA256 digest as well as their human-readable tag/version where the registry supports digests.
tommye123/docker-autoheal is this project's own published image, not a third-party dependency. Renovate should not manage it.
